title: Multiple Myeloma Lesion Segmentation on Whole-Body Diffusion-Weighted Imaging via Efficient Anatomical Anticipation and Multimodal Confirmation
abstract: arXiv:2609.06165v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Whole-body diffusion-weighted imaging (WB-DWI) is widely used for multiple myeloma (MM) assessment, yet automated lesion segmentation remains challenging due to limited anatomical delineation and the low specificity of marrow hyperintensity. Existing studies have introduced bone region-of-interest (ROI) information and apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps to mitigate these ambiguities, but practical limitations remain. Bone ROI construction often relies on costly manual annotation, image registration, or dedicated bone models, while ADC is usually incorporated only through simple channel fusion, limiting its ability to provide complementary structural and lesion-discriminative cues. To address these limitations, we propose a two-stage framework for MM lesion segmentation on WB-DWI. translated_title: 基于高效解剖预测与多模态确认的全身弥散加权成像多发性骨髓瘤病灶分割
translated_abstract: 全身弥散加权成像（WB-DWI）被广泛应用于多发性骨髓瘤（MM）的评估，但由于解剖结构勾画有限以及骨髓高信号的特异性较低，自动化病灶分割仍然充满挑战。现有研究引入了骨感兴趣区域（ROI）信息和表观弥散系数（ADC）图来缓解这些模糊性，但仍存在实际局限。骨ROI的构建通常依赖昂贵的人工标注、图像配准或专门的骨骼模型，而ADC通常仅通过简单的通道融合方式引入，限制了其提供互补的结构信息和病灶判别线索的能力。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种用于WB-DWI上MM病灶分割的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，我们在无需专门骨骼标注的情况下从ADC图像训练骨ROI生成模型，提供了一种高效且实用的解剖（预测方法）……
tldr: 该论文提出一种两阶段框架，通过无需骨骼标注、直接从ADC图像生成骨ROI实现高效解剖预测，并结合多模态确认机制，显著提升了全身弥散加权成像上多发性骨髓瘤病灶的自动分割精度与实用性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage framework that efficiently anticipates anatomical bone ROIs directly from ADC images without dedicated bone labels and employs multimodal confirmation, improving the accuracy and practicality of automated multiple myeloma lesion segmentation on whole-body diffusion-weighted imaging.
